issue_context.title: add go-deadlock to find the deadlock in the unit test
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

In https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/39584, we invoke SetGlobal of variable A in the Validation of variable B. This brought a circular dependency in rebuildSysVarCache. It will lead to deadlock. so we need a way to find the deadlock in the CI as soon as possible.

review_comments: Do you have a plan for the rest of all other `sync.RWMutex` usage in TiDB?
Yes, But deadlock detection will slow the test so I need to slowly transition to ```syncutil```.
